opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the trial Court has wrongly convicted and sentenced the appellants.
As per prosecution, the allegation against the appellants is that they kidnapped the prosecutrix from the lawful guardianship of her parents and took her in the forest and and committed sexual intercourse with the her without her consent on the pretext of marriage.
The prosecution has failed to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt therefore, benefit of doubt ought to have been given to the appellants.
The appellants have already undergone about 10 years of incarceration, therefore, in the light of law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Saudan Singh Vs. The State of Pappu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161720287/
1 Uttar Pradesh [SLP (Cri.) No.4633/2021], the application may be considered on the ground of period of incarceration.
This appeal is of the year 2015 and there is no possibility of early hearing of the appeal in near future.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS: There are material contradictions and omissions in the testimonies of the prosecution witnesses.
